cause: FQ3'24 revenue $78.4M beat guidance high end, operating loss (-$25.8M) far better than guided (-$40M to -$46M), customer engagements +80% YoY to 445, partner bookings +337% YoY
quality: 质量存疑: headline beat is real, but Total RPO declined 28.8% YoY as the company transitions to consumption-based pricing, meaning the forward bookings pipeline is shrinking even as reported revenue and engagement counts rise
reason: The beat is largely a cost-discipline story (opex loss much smaller than guided) layered on top of a pricing-model transition that management itself says makes RPO comparisons noisy - but a 28.8% YoY RPO decline is still a real deterioration in booked forward revenue, not just an optics issue. FCF was negative this quarter (-$45.1M) and the CFO announced departure the same call, adding execution/governance uncertainty right as the business model transitions.
red_flags: 总RPO同比下滑28.8%(订单储备萎缩,与营收/客户数增长背离);本季度自由现金流为负$45.1M;CFO同时段离职
